decisions.decision: internal/vehicleref is a NEW module mirroring internal/clock; one standalone change named platform-add-vehicle-authorization-seam
decisions.why: The two halves cannot compile apart, so roadmap tiers would ship a broken tier 1. Module ownership was put to the user as a gate.

decisions.decision: Account-wide ports take a LIST — ...ForVehicles(ctx, refs []vehicleref.Ref), SQL tesla_id = ANY($1). Recorded for MAG-67/68/69; no port changes here
decisions.why: The vehicle list is already in hand at all 4 gateway call sites, so the list costs no extra query. Singular would run N queries per dashboard render.

decisions.decision: An empty []Ref logs a warning and returns zero rows, never an error. Gateway keeps its len(registered) > 0 guard
decisions.why: Empty is fail-closed and 'user has no cars' is a real state, not an error. The guard stops a new user logging a warning on every render.

decisions.decision: vehicleref.Authorize(owned []int64, want int64) (Ref, bool) plus a new make vehicleref-guard, escape hatch // vehicleref:allow:
decisions.why: Go has no friend packages. An unexported field blocks only a struct literal, so an exported constructor would let a handler skip the check and still compile.

decisions.decision: Package surface is exactly Authorize, All, TeslaIDs and Ref.TeslaID()
decisions.why: TeslaIDs stops each module's SQL layer rewriting the same unwrap loop. Two plain functions are more idiomatic than a named Refs slice type.

decisions.decision: Scope is the seam only — zero module ports touched, everything additive
decisions.why: The ticket's Done when asks only for the package and the helper. Adopting it now would pull in 3 modules and change behaviour while account_id is still the real boundary.

decisions.decision: Names confirmed: package internal/vehicleref, type Ref
decisions.why: internal/vehicle was an old package replaced by the tesla adapter, so reusing that name would confuse anyone reading git history.

decisions.decision: Unit tests INCLUDED for the seam only, overriding the ticket's 'excluded' line
decisions.why: This is the part of MAG-63 where a mistake leaks another user's data. Tests cover authorizeVehicle and Ref construction only.

decisions.decision: Dispatched the artifacts worker as the gateway sub-agent on Sonnet, sandbox extended to the change folder
decisions.why: The helper lands in gateway and its AGENTS.md carries the new rule. There is no internal/platform module to own a platform- change. Every decision was pre-settled, so Sonnet was enough.
